title: Water
body:
Syntax: (no command of its own -- a personal trait revealed by channeling a Chakra Paper, see 'help channel')

Description: One of the five chakra natures (see 'help elements'). Water Dragon Jutsu (Ninjutsu, level 20) requires Water to cast at all, and carries a real chance to inflict Drained -- steadily sapping the target's own chakra each round for a few rounds.

Boosted near open water (ocean, river, lake) and in swamps. Weakened in the desert.

Date: 2026-08-26

Second nature choices at level 25:
Water + Fire: Boil Release (help boil release)
Water + Wind: Ice Release (help ice release)
Water + Earth: Wood Release (help wood release)
Water + Lightning: Storm Release (help storm release)
